cohort: Singleton pregnant women (18 years or older, gestational age > 28 weeks) with complaints of pruritis (in palm and sole) presenting to a tertiary care teaching hospital in North India.
finding: Pregnant women with IHCP had significantly higher rates of cesarean delivery, low birth weight, meconium-stained liquor, and NICU admission compared to those without IHCP.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were significantly higher among women with IHCP (58.5%) compared to those without IHCP (35.4%).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was assessed, but specific weight ranges are not provided.
